scope: Screen underrepresented open-source 3D consumer routes and assess whether they add independent parser or ACIS semantic evidence, without changing implementation or support scope.

notPerformed: repository clone, application installation, or package installation

observed: The project describes a .NET 10 DWG/DXF application, an ACadSharp-backed IO layer, and rendering for common 2D/3D entities plus ACIS SAT/SAB geometry.
Its headless TraceCli supports wireframe, hidden-line, and shaded rendering; project documentation describes render statistics, unsupported/fallback diagnostics, and JSON export.
The IO project references the ACadSharp source project directly; it is therefore another ACadSharp-backed application route, not an independent parser family.
limits: The reviewed documentation is mutable and project-authored; no immutable app release, exact submodule commit, or runtime result was established.
A rendered image or primitive count does not prove DXF/DWG wire preservation, owner-graph closure, or exact B-rep validity.
The ACIS rendering claim does not establish a kernel independent of other already-reviewed routes.
evidence.planAction: Add ProCad only as an optional one-time composed application/render consumer if exact source/submodule revisions and the required runtime are already available. Pin both revisions, platform, options and input; compare source identity/owner inventory, output dispositions, renderer diagnostics, bounds, primitive/body counts, and an independent expected manifest. Count parser evidence with ACadSharp and do not grant independent-kernel or ACIS semantic credit.

observed: The official blender-addons mirror is archived; the DXF addon identifies version 0.9.8 and credits the dxfgrabber library lineage.
The manual describes mapping DXF records into Blender curves and meshes.
The optional ACIS action exports payloads for BODY, REGION, PLANESURFACE, SURFACE, and 3DSOLID to SAT/SAB sidecar files; this is raw-carrier extraction, not solid interpretation.
dxfgrabber labels itself outdated and directs users to ezdxf.
limits: Blender mesh/curve output is a consumer projection and can merge source entities; it is not a lossless CAD graph round trip.
The optional sidecar export does not provide an ACIS kernel, B-rep validation, or DWG AcDs association evidence.
The addon is archived and related to the ezdxf author/parser lineage, so it is neither a current independent parser vote nor a modern broad-format gate.
evidence.planAction: Exclude by default from independent DXF, DWG, and ACIS semantic evidence. If already available, it may be used once as an explicit-geometry projection check with exact Blender/addon versions, merge/transform settings, source-item disposition, and output topology; do not install it, add a test/dependency, or count SAT/SAB extraction as parsing.

optionalRouteOrder: Continue local generated tests and touched-target strict builds without waiting for these consumers.
At the existing composed consumer checkpoint, consider ProCad only when the exact app/submodule build and runtime are already available.
Treat Blender's archived importer as an explicit-geometry projection only; default disposition is EXCLUDED / NOT_RUN.
implementationReadiness.fixturePolicy: Use only locally generated controls already permitted by the plan and keep them temporary; no external DWG/DXF/SAT/SAB fixture is added.
